decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approaches to the outer cameras, keeping each arm on its own side. Plan pen in white, cars in blue, cameras in red, with a center relay for the left camera.
Pitch grippers downward and advance above the two outer cameras. Keep open while refining alignment from wrist views.
Center the cameras in each wrist view, descend slightly, close both grippers and begin a small retention-test lift.
Lift both cameras clear. Move the right camera toward the red basket and the left camera toward a front-center relay, without crossing arms.
Left camera appears retained; carry it to the center relay. The right camera slipped onto the table, so reopen and rotate to grasp across its shorter dimension.
Set the retained left camera down at the centerline relay and release. Finish aligning the right gripper across the dropped camera's narrow dimension while descending.
Withdraw the left arm from the relay toward the yellow car. Refine right camera alignment, close across its width, and test retention with a short lift.
Carry the visibly retained right camera upward and toward the red basket. Lower the left open gripper around the yellow toy vehicle.
Replan the right basket approach with smaller forward increments while lowering to avoid the rejected joint jump. Grasp and lightly lift the centered yellow vehicle.
Release the first camera inside the red basket and withdraw toward the remaining right-side camera. Carry the retained yellow vehicle toward the blue basket.
Lower the yellow vehicle over the left portion of the blue basket. Approach the second camera with the right gripper open, preserving the established wrist orientation.
The yellow vehicle slipped near the blue front rim; withdraw to inspect it. Make the right camera approach more vertical and shift away from the red rim before closing.
Close on the second camera and lift vertically to verify retention. Move the left open gripper toward the white pen, rotating to pinch across its narrow dimension.
The second camera was not retained. Reopen and center more directly over it while descending. Finish the white-pen wrist alignment and lower carefully for a pinch.
Pinch the centered white pen and lift toward the white basket. Correct the right camera's lateral offset with open jaws, then close and test a small lift.
Neither object appears securely held. Reopen, return over the white pen, and lower both grippers to engage the object sides rather than their tops.
Close at the white pen's table-level pinch and lift without lateral motion. The right gripper is obstructed near the basket rim; lift and rotate to approach the camera from the front.
Transport the visibly pinched white pen toward the white basket. Recenter the right camera approach with a standard forward-down gripper orientation, clear of the red rim.
Use smaller forward/down steps after the left IK interruption, then release the pen inside white. Lower and close the right gripper around the camera from its unobstructed front side.
Lift the camera securely clear before translating toward red. Withdraw the left arm from white to inspect the released pen and begin alignment with the remaining gold-and-black pen.

Replan from the interrupted observation with small retreat increments. Raise the held camera well above the basket rim before carrying it inward; the white pen remains outside and will need another pickup.
Place the retained camera deeper into red and release from above the rim. Reapproach the displaced white pen with its new diagonal orientation.
Correct the rejected tensor without compensating for unexecuted motion. Lower toward the white pen and withdraw the right arm toward the camera relay.
Stop downward pressure at the left contact, close on the pen, then test a vertical lift. Align the right arm over the relay camera without crossing the centerline.
Reopen after the empty pen lift and approach its free section farther from the basket. Lower the right gripper around the relay camera, using a slight inward tilt while keeping its EE on the right.
Pinch the white pen at table level and test a vertical lift. Move the right camera pinch slightly toward its body, close, and lift without sideways motion.
Carry the retained relay camera toward red with extra rim clearance. Refine the white-pen pinch laterally and reduce the opening near table height before the final close.
Fine-center the white pen between the jaws before closing and lifting. Carry the third camera above the red basket without releasing near its front rim.
Move the retained white pen fully above white, turning the wrist to gain forward clearance. Advance the third camera into the red interior and release, completing that category if it settles.
The white pen is leaning over the front rim; try to recover it and advance with small clearance steps. Withdraw the open right gripper so the three cameras settle, then approach the wooden car.
The white pen has fallen flat and is now accessible. Approach it across its width while bringing the right gripper above the wooden car; leave the camera basket undisturbed.
Replan from the IK interruption: retreat the left gripper backward and slightly upward to clear the white rim before another descent. Center and lower the right gripper over the wooden car.
Descend over the white pen now clear of the rim. Refine the wooden-car pinch across its width, close, and begin a short vertical retention test.
Fine-center and close on the thin white pen before testing a lift. Raise the wooden car well clear of the basket rim while maintaining the closed grip.
Raise the retained white pen and turn both wrists to forward-facing placement orientations, reducing the required arm reach. Carry the wooden car above the blue interior, keeping both grips closed.
Release the wooden car centrally into blue and retreat toward the red car. The white pen was not retained; reposition the left pinch farther along its body and approach lower with the jaws open.
Make a deeper, slowly closing pinch on the centered white pen and test only a small lift. Bring the right open gripper over the red car, aligned across its width.
Verify the white pen with a larger purely vertical lift before transport. Fine-align the red car grip, descend across its narrow width, close, and begin a short retention lift.
The white pen stayed on the table. Change to a more vertical pinch over its body and reopen for a centered descent. Lift the retained red car clear and start its blue-basket transfer.
Shift the vertical left pinch onto the white pen's body using the wrist view, then close and test lift. Carry the visibly retained red car over the blue basket with rim clearance.
Replan the right basket approach after the joint-continuity interruption using smaller forward and downward steps. Let the left pinch finish closing, then lift vertically to verify the pen.

The white pen is now visibly retained; carry it toward the white interior with a small forward tilt for clearance. Advance the retained red car beyond the blue front rim, release, and begin withdrawing.
Release the retained white pen well inside white, then withdraw. Move the right arm away from the completed placements, preserving clearance and elbow-up continuity.
The white pen is inside its basket. Approach the remaining gold-and-black pen with a vertical pinch across its shaft, while returning the unused right arm toward home.
Refine the gold-and-black pen alignment from the wrist view and descend vertically over its shaft. Continue the right arm's smooth elbow-up return toward its origin.
Pinch the centered pen shaft with a slow closure and test a vertical lift. Finish returning the right arm to its origin, with its gripper open.
Carry the visibly retained gold-and-black pen toward white, adding a small forward tilt to clear the basket rim without extending the arm fully. Keep the right arm at home.
Advance the retained pen fully over the white interior with small forward/down steps, then open to release it beside the white pen.
Allow the released pen to settle in white, then withdraw toward the final yellow vehicle with the left gripper open. Keep the right arm at home.
Move the left arm above the final yellow vehicle at the blue basket's front, unwinding the wrist to a conventional pinch orientation. Preserve clearance while the pen basket settles.
Correct the left wrist to a vertical grasp and align directly above the upright yellow vehicle, keeping the open fingers clear of the blue rim.
Advance the vertical pinch slightly toward the upright yellow vehicle and lower around its body, then close while stationary.
Lift the yellow vehicle with the gripper closed and a slight backward retreat to clear the blue rim; verify that the object follows before transferring it.
The yellow vehicle follows the gripper. Tilt the held vehicle forward and advance slowly above the blue interior, retaining extra height over the front rim.
Release the last vehicle over the blue interior, allow it to settle, and begin withdrawing the open left gripper toward its origin.
All objects appear grouped inside their category baskets. Return the left arm smoothly toward home with its gripper open and let the vehicles settle.
Finish the left arm's controlled return to its origin, keeping both grippers open and leaving the separated objects undisturbed to settle.
